_note: Pluggable LLM 'brain' for reasoning/vision calls (scene intelligence, image matcher, segmenter). Default provider is openai (current behaviour). Switch with env LLM_PROVIDER=openai|bedrock|gemini, or change 'provider' here. Per-tier models overridable via env LLM_REASONING_MODEL / LLM_VISION_MODEL / LLM_FAST_MODEL. Tiers: reasoning (creative direction), vision (high-quality vision), fast (cheap vision-capable model for bulk describes + image QC). Image generation and audio are separate axes and not controlled here.

bedrock._note: Sonnet 4.6 via the us.* cross-region inference profile (verified live 2026-06-10). Claude 4.x requires an inference profile for on-demand; the bare foundation-model id is rejected. The profile routes across us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2, so the IAM policy must allow foundation-model ARNs in all those regions + the inference-profile ARN. The 'fast' Haiku profile id follows the same us.* convention — verify once live (override via LLM_FAST_MODEL if it differs). Bedrock uses IAM (instance role / AWS profile) — no API key.
